# WebCrawler.buzz — Free Website Crawler Online | Web Crawler Tool Free

> A free online web crawler and URL crawler to crawl any website online and generate a comprehensive SEO audit report. Use our website crawler online free at webcrawler.buzz — also known as DomainCrawler.

## Overview

WebCrawler.buzz (DomainCrawler) is a free website crawler online that lets you crawl a website online to discover every page. This online webcrawler uses breadth-first search (BFS) scoped to a root domain and extracts page-level SEO data. Whether you need a web crawler online, a URL crawler, or want to test crawl a website — this free site crawler is completely free to use with no sign-up required.

## What It Does

Paste any URL and this web crawler online will:
- Crawl every discoverable page on the domain
- Extract page titles, meta descriptions, HTTP status codes, response times, content types, page sizes
- Count internal and external links on each page
- Detect redirect chains and final redirect URLs
- Check indexability status of each page
- Generate a paginated, searchable results table
- Export results as CSV with email delivery

## Key Features

- Free website crawler — no registration, no limits on pages
- Website crawler online free — works from any browser, no install needed
- Online web crawler and URL crawler with real-time progress tracking
- Crawl website online with duplicate domain detection and re-crawl option
- Web crawler free online — also works as a site crawler free tool
- Free web crawler with webcrawler online dashboard
- Crawl site online for SEO audits and test crawl website before migrations
- Paginated results view (50, 100, 500, or 1000 results per page)
- CSV export with download link sent via email
- Email notifications when crawl completes
- Shareable tracking URLs — bookmark or share your crawl progress
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Use Cases

- SEO audits: Use this free online web crawler for website health checks
- Broken link detection: URL crawler finds 4xx and 5xx status codes
- Site structure analysis via internal/external link counts (site crawler online)
- Page speed analysis via response times (web crawler test)
- Indexability verification across an entire domain (domain crawler online)
- Meta data auditing (missing titles, duplicate descriptions)
- Content type and page size analysis (website url crawler)
- Website migration validation (test crawl website before going live)
- Free website crawl for quick site audits (crawler free, crawling online)
